description: He wears a floor-length cream textured tunic with a narrow round neckline, long full sleeves and wide purple-and-gold woven borders at the collar, cuffs and hem. A deep purple long outer layer and draped shoulder cloth have elaborate gold geometric edging, secured near anatomical left shoulder with a small circular clasp. A narrow decorated waist belt has a purple-red centered round fitting. Brown leather boots show below the hem. The fabric layers are opaque, flowing but structured at the waist, and unarmored. No headgear, weapon or ceremonial crown appears. Exact fibers cannot be verified; cream cloth looks linen-like and purple layers have a dense woven texture.
